items.title: Sign and return offer letter to accept
items.quote:
To accept, please sign the enclosed offer letter and return it to People Operations no later
than March 26, 2025.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date by which the signed offer must be returned: March 26, 2025. This is a date set by a private company (not a German authority), so no deemed-delivery or BGB period-counting rules apply; the date is taken as written. March 26, 2025 is a Wednesday, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed.

items.title: Employment start date
items.quote:
starting May 5, 2025, at an annual base salary
of EUR 92,000.00.
items.computation: The letter states the employment start date directly as May 5, 2025; this is a fixed date printed in the letter, taken as written.

warnings: This is a job offer from a private US company (not a German authority), so statutory deemed-delivery and BGB deadline-counting rules do not apply; the 'no later than March 26, 2025' date is a company-imposed acceptance deadline, not a legal one.

The sender's address and phone/email are US-based (San Francisco) while the employee is to work from Germany 'through our employer of record' — verify the employer-of-record arrangement and the sender's legitimacy before signing, as offer-letter scams sometimes use this structure.
